objective.title: Fix a Docker multi-stage build
objective.description: The Dockerfile ships the full build toolchain and source in its final image. Rewrite it as a proper multi-stage build: compile in a builder stage, then copy only the resulting binary into a minimal final stage.

checks.description: The built image's final layer does not contain the Go toolchain
checks.probe: docker run --rm --entrypoint sh docker-multistage-bloat-v1:lab -c '! which go >/dev/null 2>&1'

checks.description: The built image is under 100MB (the buggy fixture is ~1.27GB; a correct multi-stage build onto a minimal base measured ~15.5MB)
